Game Overview

In Pumpkin Hop, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a spooky world with "Pumpkin Hop," where precision jumps and strategic timing are your keys to success. Navigate haunting landscapes filled with obstacles and collect festive treasures. With vibrant graphics and charming animations, every leap is thrilling in this addictive Halloween adventure.
